guarantees.claim: idle_o is always equal to idle_q.

assumptions.claim: When msg_fifo_req and msg_fifo_we are both asserted, wmask_byte must be either all zeros or all ones (byte-aligned write mask).
assumptions.risk: A non-byte-aligned mask could cause partial word writes, corrupting the FIFO data and potentially the HMAC computation.

uncertain_points.claim: The wmask_byte alignment constraint is only checked in formal verification (disabled for Verilator and synthesis); no hardware mechanism detects or prevents a non-byte-aligned access.
uncertain_points.risk: Violation could silently corrupt internal state, leading to incorrect HMAC results without error propagation.
